title: 법률구조법 시행규칙 / queue:ARTICLE:5:0:00005:part:1/1
full_text:
Article 5 (Accounting)
(1) A corporation registered with the Minister of Justice under Article 3 of the Act shall record all accounting transactions on an accrual basis, in accordance with corporate accounting principles, so as to accurately ascertain business performance and revenue and expenditure. <Amended on Feb. 7, 2022>
(2) The accounting of a corporation registered with the Minister of Justice under Article 3 of the Act shall be divided into accounting for activities undertaken for legal aid purposes and accounting for profit-making activities.
